ItemID: 1; Title: Digital Clamp Meter MESTEK Inrush Current Meter 1000A AC/DC Volt Amp Ohm Meter Clamp on Multimeter True RMS 6000 Counts NCV VFD LOZ Measures Current Voltage Temperature Capacitance Resistance; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for electrical troubleshooting alongside my inspection camera and measuring tools.
ItemID: 2; Title: Adhesive Guru CA Glue with Activator Woodworking (3.5 oz - 13,5 fl oz) Ca Glue for Woodworking, Cyanoacrylate Glue and Activator (1 Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Quick bonding would be useful for small repairs where my mounting tape or epoxy is less convenient.
ItemID: 3; Title: Gaffers Tape - Professional Grade Gaffers Tape 4 Inch x 33 Yards, Waterproof, Non-Reflective, No Residue Cloth Camera Tape Multipurpose Matte Finish Black Gaffers Tape for Photography Filming Backdrop; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have mounting tapes, and I do not currently need wide temporary cloth tape.
ItemID: 4; Title: HJ Acrylic Casted Clear Sheet Plexiglass Sheet Thickness 2mm With Protect Film for Frame, Painting, Signs, Family DIY Projects (8, 8 inches x 10 inches ); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These could suit a small DIY build, but I would wait until I have a project with matching dimensions.
ItemID: 5; Title: TRYMAG Small Strong Magnets, Rare Earth Magnets, 3 Size 75pcs, Small Neodymium Magnets Black Fridge Magnets for Whiteboard, Billboard, Hobbies, Office, Round Button Magnets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Small magnets could help with fixtures, but I need a specific holding-strength requirement before choosing them.
ItemID: 6; Title: ELOOGAA 3Pcs Solderless Breadboard 830 Point Solderless Prototype PCB Board Kit for Arduino Proto Shield Distribution Connecting Blocks; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current projects lean toward mechanical repairs and fabrication rather than circuit prototyping.
ItemID: 7; Title: LIONMAX #10 x 5" Deck Screws, 300 PCS Exterior Wood Screws 5 Inch with Star Drive, Long Wood Screws for Outdoor Use, Coarse Threads, Anti-Rust, Drive Bit Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use assorted fasteners, but I have no current outdoor build needing this many long deck screws.
ItemID: 8; Title: Eshazu Premium General Purpose Scuff Pads 6" x 9", Box of 10 - Scuffing, Scouring, Sanding, Paint Primer Prep Adhesion Scratch - Surface Preparation of Woodworking & Any General Work (Variety Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Surface preparation would be useful before adhesive bonding, resin work, or finishing fabricated parts.
ItemID: 9; Title: luxvoko 4Pcs Pegboard Wall Organizer Panels, Wall Control PegBoard Combination Kit 10''x10''ABS Drillable Peg Boards for Wall Display or Storage in Craft Room Garage Kitchen Office Study Room; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Organizing my growing tool collection appeals to me, but I would check panel capacity and mounting space first.
ItemID: 10; Title: Realth Magnets Rare Earth Magnetic Rectangular Magnet 1.97” x 0.39” x 0.2” 6 Pack for Warehouse Office Science Project Teaching Shower Door and Craft DIY (MC721); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for removable workshop fixtures where my screws, rivets, and mounting tape are less convenient.
